input.recap: Both the report's test tables and the website's test catalog now sort when you click a column header: ascending, then descending, then back to the usual order. I checked both in the browser, and the report builds. Nothing is committed yet, and the changes are sitting on the unrelated fix/sponsor-page-org-block branch.
input.ask: Move these to a new branch and open a PR that closes issue 2750?

content.text:
I added sorting to both, because each had a test table you couldn't sort. The issue asks for it on the report's **All tests** page: Result, Severity, Source, Product and Test ID, in either direction.

The column headers are now buttons. The first click sorts ascending, the second sorts descending, and the third goes back to the usual order. Ascending means failures first, then the most severe first, then A to Z. Tests with no value (no severity, no product) stay at the bottom in both directions. When the list is grouped, sorting applies within each group.

**Report** (`report/`)
- [lists.tsx](report/src/components/report/lists.tsx): `TestTable` gets sortable headers for all five columns, with `aria-sort` set, so every list using it can sort: All tests, product pages, pack pages and Changes. A new `sortRows` function does the ordering.
- On All tests, the sort is kept with the filters and grouping, so it survives opening a test and coming back. **Copy as Markdown** copies the rows in the sorted order.

**Website** (`website/src/components/catalog/`)
- The catalog's ID, Check, Product (Feature on a product page) and Severity headers sort. The sort is saved in the URL (`?sort=severity`, `?sort=-id`), so a sorted view can be shared.
- I added `sort` to the catalog's URL state, alongside `group`, as a display setting rather than a filter. Clearing filters keeps it, and it doesn't count as "filtered".

**Checks:** I tested each column in both directions in the running report and on the local site, including within groups. `npm run build` for the report passes. I didn't touch `ReportTemplate.html`, because the build-maester-report-template workflow regenerates it.

**Limits:**
- On narrow screens the catalog hides its header row, as it did before, so you can't sort there.
- The changes aren't committed. They're on `fix/sponsor-page-org-block`, which already has an unrelated commit on it, so they should move to their own branch.

input.ask: Move sorting and columns to a new branch and open a PR for issue 2750?

content.text:
The report and the website catalog both have a column picker now. Readers can add or remove columns, and every column sorts the same way as before: ascending, then descending, then back to the usual order.

**Report** (every test table: All tests, product pages, pack pages, Changes)
- A columns icon sits at the right end of the table header. Result and Test are always shown.
- The other columns can be turned on or off: Product, Feature, Area, Severity, User impact, Effort, Resource, ATT&CK, Controls, Source and Duration. The menu has a **Reset to default** option.
- A column that no test in the report has a value for is left out of the menu.
- The choice applies to every table and is saved in the reader's browser (`localStorage`). If storage is blocked, the report falls back to the default columns.
- With many columns the table scrolls sideways. The columns icon stays pinned on the right so you can always reach it.
- The changes are in [lists.tsx](report/src/components/report/lists.tsx) and [ReportContext.tsx](report/src/components/report/ReportContext.tsx).

**Website** (catalog list, [CatalogList.astro](website/src/components/catalog/CatalogList.astro))
- A **Columns** menu sits next to Group by. ID and Check are always shown. The other columns are Product (Feature on a product page), Feature, Area, Severity, User impact, Effort, ATT&CK, Controls and Source.
- The choice is saved in the browser. Unlike the sort, it isn't added to the URL.
- The table scrolls sideways once the columns no longer fit. Phones keep the current compact layout without the extra columns.

**Checks:** I tested adding columns, sorting by them, the saved choice and reset in both, at desktop and phone widths, with no console errors. The report build passes.

**Limits:**
- The website has no type-check set up (`astro check` needs a package the repo doesn't install), so its script was only checked by running it in the dev server.
- The Controls column shows raw keys such as `nist-800-53-r5:IA-5(1)`, the same values the test's `Control` attribute holds. It cuts off after two keys and shows the rest on hover.
- None of this is committed, and it's still on the `fix/sponsor-page-org-block` branch.
Branch and PR

I pushed a fix to [maester365/maester#2777](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2777) as commit `011cdb252`. CI hasn't re-run on it yet; Auto-fix will tell me if anything still fails.

Five were one-line functions that returned the result of a call with no return value, so I put each body in braces. The sixth was flagged as an XSS risk, but the function only receives a column key and a true/false value, no HTML. I renamed it (`toggle` → `showColumn`), which should clear the rule.
- **CodeRabbit:** two small points on the website catalog, both valid, both fixed:
  - `LEVELS` is now declared before the sort table that uses it.
  - The catalog's page-wide click listener is now removed when the list leaves the page, so it isn't added twice if the list is put back.
- **Not acted on:**
  - CodeRabbit wants the PR cut back to sorting on All tests only, but the column picker and the website changes are what you asked for.
  - It also asks for docstrings, which the report code doesn't use elsewhere.
  - The bot reminder about the "How Maester works" explainer needs no update: the explainer covers how a run works, and nothing it shows changed.

After the fix I checked the report and the website again: columns add, reset and sort as before.
